message.content:
This editorial illustration depicts a magazine cover. At the top, a red bar contains white text: “Mengapa Pemerintah Melindungi Konglomerat”. Below, the word “TEMPO” is printed in large, white, serif letters. Smaller white text reads “EDISI 21 - 27 Januari 2002”. Large yellow text in the center reads “JURUS MATADOR AKBAR”.

The main image shows a composite figure with a man's head superimposed on a matador's body. He wears a yellow, gold-trimmed suit and spectacles. He is positioned on the right, facing left. He holds a green cloth with a wooden handle, which has the words “RAUDATUL JANNAH” printed on it in black. A large black bull is positioned in the center, facing the green cloth. The matador and bull are inside what appears to be a stone bullfighting arena with arched galleries in the background. The entire scene is overlaid with a textured, rainy effect. At the bottom right, the text “Akbar Tanjung” appears in white, and the price “Rp 14.700” is in the corner. A barcode is at the bottom left. A thin red border frames the entire cover.
